crossRefs.note: Solomon had a vineyard at Baal Hamon. He leased out the vineyard to keepers. Each was to bring a thousand shekels of…
My own vineyard is before me. The thousand are for you, Solomon, two hundred for those who tend its fruit.
“Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household, who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it…
I will lay it a wasteland. It won’t be pruned or hoed, but it will grow briers and thorns. I will also command the…
Beat your breasts for the pleasant fields, for the fruitful vine.
I saw, and behold, the fruitful field was a wilderness, and all its cities were broken down at the presence of Yahweh…
but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

translations.web: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silver shekels, shall be for briers and thorns.
translations.bsb: And on that day, in every place that had a thousand vines worth a thousand shekels of silver, only briers and thorns will be found.
translations.kjv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place shall be, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, it shall even be for briers and thorns.
translations.asv: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, shall be for briers and thorns.
